thread:
Talia M: Heads-up — opening a docs PR to add a deprecation notice for `aurora-lite-1.5b-legacy` and add migration guidance to the model card. Legacy variant will be removed from hosted routing in two weeks.

Ethan B: Dropping PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5233. Plan: add a "Deprecation" banner, migration steps, bench pointers for new `aurora-lite-1.5b-q4_0` and update SDK snippets to show explicit variant selection. Also fix a broken link that currently points to /docs/models/aurora-lite#legacy (404).

Priya S: Important: call out that hosted customers who pinned `aurora-lite-1.5b:latest` will be auto-migrated to `aurora-lite-1.5b@stable` which picks the supported variant. But we should recommend explicit pinning for reproducibility: `aurora-lite-1.5b@v3`. Add a one-line rollback note for Dedicated/Private.

Ethan B: Bench context (internal): aurora-lite-1.5b-q4_0 on T4 seq256: peak w/ KV cache ~1.8GB, w/o KV ~2.4GB. Legacy fp16 variant peak ~3.7GB. Adding a small comparison table in the card and linking the internal bench run: https://bench.internal/redwood/aurora-lite-1.5b-2026.

Ethan B: ```
Model                        seq256   w/KV-cache   w/o-KV
aurora-lite-1.5b-q4_0       1.8GB     1.8GB        2.4GB
aurora-lite-1.5b-legacy     3.7GB     3.7GB        4.1GB
```

Talia M: Good. For SDK snippets, include both a minimal example (explicit variant) and a defensive example that specifies a fallback and a note about deployment differences. Example (JS) I'm drafting: 

Talia M: ```js
// prefer explicit variant selection
await client.generate({
  model: "aurora-lite-1.5b-q4_0",
  max_tokens: 128
})

// defensive: prefer q4_0 but fallback to fp16 (honored in Dedicated/Private)
await client.generate({
  model: "aurora-lite-1.5b-q4_0",
  fallback: ["aurora-lite-1.5b-legacy"],
  max_tokens: 128
})
```

Priya S: Small copy edits: use "KV cache" capitalization; add the sentence: "Hosted routing may route to a compatible variant based on capacity; explicit `fallback` ordering is honored on Dedicated/Private deployments." And add the deprecation timeline: "Hosted remove date: 2026-04-15".

Ethan B: Added the migration checklist to the PR: (1) search for pinned `aurora-lite-1.5b:latest`, (2) pin to `aurora-lite-1.5b@v3` to opt into q4_0, (3) test locally with `--kv-cache` toggled, (4) add fallback policy for Dedicated/Private if needed.
